CRYPTO.title: [BTC/USD] DOWN: ETF Outflows and Exchange Deposit Spike Signal Bearish Momentum
tldr_points: Bitcoin ETFs endured eight straight weeks of net outflows despite a Thursday inflow, indicating persistent institutional selling pressure.
Exchange deposits for BTC and altcoins have surged, per CryptoQuant, heralding higher volatility and potential short‑term downside.
Price sits above the 20‑day MA but RSI remains below 50, suggesting a short‑term bearish bias with upside capped near MA20.
CRYPTO.excerpt: BTC/USD faces downside pressure from ETF outflows and rising exchange deposits; technicals show bullish bias near MA20.
CRYPTO.comment: ETF outflows and rising exchange deposits point to near‑term downside despite price hovering above MA20.
